description: Edit-model fixtures from the design stress test. Each applies ops to input and must produce expected. Models: m1 = one paragraph, m3 = paragraph breaks (a+ = split/join with typed join, b2 = break as text with \n escape), m4 = comments. Notes marked INVENTED or PROPOSED encode a choice where the current spec is silent. Attribution here follows the ledger layout used before 2026-10-14 ({by: ...} entries in the ledger); regenerate these with layout D (author and time in the marker) when packages/format is built.
